interpretation: Under the observational adjustment assumptions, late delivery is estimated to reduce review score by about 1.570 points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.585, -1.554]).
method: Doubly Robust AIPW with propensity adjustment and bootstrap uncertainty
assumptions: No unmeasured confounding after adjustment for included pre-treatment covariates.
Positivity / overlap holds for the analyzed population.
Treatment definition correctly captures late delivery.
Observed data are representative of the target population for this estimate.
limitations: This is observational causal inference, not a randomized experiment.
The estimated effect is conditional on the available covariates and overlap.
Poor overlap causes the engine to downgrade or reject causal interpretation.
